subject: Finalize offer terms & DocuSign link — staggered start option
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Calvin Park <calvin.park@gmail.com>
Cc: Hiro Tanaka <hiro_tanaka@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-12T10:12:00-07:00
Subject: Offer call: Redwood Inference — Senior Infrastructure Engineer

Hi Calvin,

Really excited to follow up — the hiring team is prepared to extend a formal offer for the Senior Infrastructure Engineer role. I attached the initial offer letter (Offer_Letter_v1.pdf) for transparency before our call.

Would you be available for a 20–30 min offer call to walk through compensation, benefits, and start-date logistics? Here are some windows I have:
- Tue Apr 13, 11:00–11:30 AM PT
- Tue Apr 13, 3:00–3:30 PM PT
- Wed Apr 14, 9:00–9:30 AM PT

If none of those work, tell me two times that do and I’ll loop in David (hiring manager) and HR.

A few notes: the offer includes a standard 2-week notice expectation and a proposed start date of May 3. If you want to propose an alternative phased start (part-time onboarding before full-time), mention it on the call and we can discuss options.

Thanks — would love to get this scheduled and get documents in DocuSign the same day if you’re ready.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
People Partner, Recruiting
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: Offer_Letter_v1.pdf (PDF, 54 KB)]

From: Calvin Park <calvin.park@gmail.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-12T14:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Offer call: Redwood Inference — Senior Infrastructure Engineer

Hi Vanessa,

Thanks — congrats and excited. I can do Tue Apr 13 at 3pm PT.

Quick heads up: I scanned the offer and attached a short PDF with a couple of redline requests around the start date and the first-quarter deliverable milestone (see calvin_redline.pdf). My ideal would be a staggered start: two weeks at 60% to finish a commitment at my current employer, then full-time on May 17. Salary and equity look great; the only things I’d like to adjust are the phrasing on the milestone and the explicit start-date window.

Happy to talk through — 3pm works for me.

Cheers,
Calvin
[Attachment: calvin_redline.pdf (PDF, 12 KB)]

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com>
Cc: Hiro Tanaka <hiro_tanaka@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-12T15:05:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: candidate redline — Calvin Park (offer review + routing)

Marissa / David — forwarding Calvin's redline from earlier today. He booked the 3pm PT offer call tomorrow (we'll include David). Two asks:

1) Marissa — can you please confirm whether the proposed staggered start (60% for two weeks, then full-time) is acceptable operationally and whether we should implement that as a "phased start" clause (clear dates) or as a flexible start window? If you approve, can you provide updated language we can send to the candidate and load into DocuSign?

2) David — confirm the milestone language. Calvin requested softer phrasing for the Q1 deliverable to avoid hard termination triggers. He wants an explicit ramp clause not tied to immediate termination.

We'd like to get any redlines in by EOD so we can send the final offer and DocuSign link after the call if both sides align.

Thanks —
Vanessa
People Partner, Recruiting
[Forwarded attachments: calvin_redline.pdf]

From: David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-12T17:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: candidate redline — Calvin Park (offer review + routing)

Vanessa / Marissa — thanks for the loop. I spoke with the hiring committee: we're sympathetic to the staggered start so long as the expectation on deliverables during ramp is reasonable. Proposed counter language (drafted below) removes any automatic termination tied to an early quarter milestone and replaces it with "performance checkpoints" and a 30-day coaching window.

Suggested edits (high level):
- Replace 'immediate termination for missed Q1 deliverables' with 'performance checkpoints at 60/90 days with remediation steps, not immediate termination.'
- Add explicit phased-start clause: "Start date may be phased: employee may commence part-time onboarding for up to 2 weeks at an agreed fraction of time before the official full-time start date; full-time start date to be mutually agreed and not later than May 24, 2027."

I've attached Offer_Letter_v1b.pdf with tracked changes for Marissa to confirm (Offer_Letter_v1b.pdf). If legal signs off, I'm good to proceed.

-David
Hiring Manager
[Attachment: Offer_Letter_v1b.pdf (PDF, 63 KB)]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-12T20:11:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: candidate redline — Calvin Park (offer review + routing)

Folks — reviewed David's draft and the candidate redline. Legal is comfortable with the phased-start clause and the replacement of hard termination language with checkpoints + remediation. I made minor clarifications to notice periods and payroll start date versus benefit eligibility (see edits).

Next steps:
- I attached Offer_Final.pdf with final language.
- Vanessa, once you confirm call time goes ahead, I can generate the DocuSign envelope. We'll include the phased-start clause and explicit full-time latest-start date (May 24) as agreed.
- Laura, please prepare onboarding checklist for a staggered start (access & laptop provisioning timeline).

Marissa
Senior Counsel, People Ops
[Attachment: Offer_Final.pdf (PDF, 68 KB)]

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Calvin Park <calvin.park@gmail.com>
Cc: David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-13T09:05:00-07:00
Subject: Confirming 3pm PT offer call + DocuSign link

Hi Calvin — thanks again for the conversation earlier. Good news: the team reviewed your requests and we're able to accommodate a phased (staggered) start.

Summary of final terms:
- Base salary and equity unchanged from the original offer.
- Phased start: up to two weeks of part-time onboarding at an agreed fraction, followed by full-time start no later than May 24, 2027.
- Performance phrasing: replaced immediate-termination language with 60/90-day checkpoints and remediation window.

I have prepared the final offer in DocuSign. Please sign here: https://app.docusign.com/some-long-docusign-link/ABC123

If you prefer we can review the final two paragraphs on the call at 3:00 PM PT today — David will join. If everything looks good, sign the envelope and we'll kick off onboarding.

Attachments: Offer_Final.pdf (PDF, 68 KB)

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
People Partner, Recruiting
Redwood Inference
[Related: onboarding checklist (Laura Bennett) via internal Drive: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1OfferChecklist]
